mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO chat_room_member (room_id, member_id) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{memberId})
mapper.select: SELECT r.room_id, r.title, r.created_at, COUNT(rm.member_id) AS member_count, COALESCE(MAX(rm.member_id = #{memberId}), 0) AS joined FROM chat_room r LEFT JOIN chat_room_member rm ON rm.room_id = r.room_id GROUP BY r.room_id, r.title, r.created_at ORDER BY r.room_id DESC

SELECT r.room_id, r.title, r.created_at, COUNT(rm.member_id) AS member_count, COALESCE(MAX(rm.member_id = #{memberId}), 0) AS joined FROM chat_room r LEFT JOIN chat_room_member rm ON rm.room_id = r.room_id WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId} GROUP BY r.room_id, r.title, r.created_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_member WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (room_id, sender_id, content) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT cm.message_id, cm.room_id, cm.sender_id, m.nickname AS sender_name, cm.content, cm.created_at FROM chat_message cm JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cm.sender_id WHERE cm.message_id = #{messageId}
